article.story: Virginia Tech (2-0) at Maryland (2-0), Sept. 19 at 7:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Virginia Tech by 3. Against the spread: Virginia Tech 2-0, Maryland 2-0. How to watch: Fox Networks Key stats Virginia Tech Offense Overall: 517.5 yards per game (20th in FBS) Passing: 339.0 yards per game (11th) Rushing: 178.5 yards per game (64th) Scoring: 58.5 points per game (4th) Virginia Tech Defense Overall: 196.5 yards per game (10th in FBS) Passing: 137.0 yards per game (21st) Rushing: 59.5 yards per game (9th) Scoring: 12.0 points per game (22nd) Maryland Offense Overall: 560.5 yards per game (9th in FBS) Passing: 315.5 yards per game (21st) Rushing: 245.0 yards per game (23rd) Scoring: 50.0 points per game (14th) Maryland Defense Overall: 154.0 yards per game (4th in FBS) Passing: 115.5 yards per game (7th) Rushing: 38.5 yards per game (5th) Scoring: 7.0 points per game (9th) Virginia Tech is 11th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 20.0% of third downs. Virginia Tech ranks 68th in the FBS with an even turnover margin, compared to Maryland's 10th-ranked +4 margin. Virginia Tech is 20th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 66.7% of red zone trips. Team leaders Virginia Tech Passing: Ethan Grunkemeyer, 551 yards, 4 TDs, 0 INTs, 77.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jeffrey Overton Jr., 151 yards on 23 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Luke Reynolds, 158 yards on 13 catches, 3 TDs Maryland Passing: Malik Washington, 533 yards, 3 TDs, 0 INTs, 73.6 completion percentage Rushing: Iverson Howard, 121 yards on 26 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Na'eem Abdul-Rahim Gladding, 187 yards on 14 catches, 2 TDs Last game Virginia Tech won 44-21 over Old Dominion on Sept. 12. Grunkemeyer led Virginia Tech with 327 yards on 31-of-42 passing (73.8%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball six times for -25 yards and one rushing touchdown. Overton had 47 rushing yards on 14 carries, adding four receptions for 32 yards. Reynolds had eight receptions for 108 yards and two touchdowns. Maryland won 38-14 over UConn on Sept. 12. Washington threw for 347 yards on 34-of-41 attempts (82.9%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Howard carried the ball 14 times for 55 yards and scored one touchdown, adding three receptions for nine yards. Gladding put up 130 yards on eight catches with one touchdown. Next game Virginia Tech plays at Boston College on Sept. 26. Maryland hosts UCLA on Sept. 26.
